quests.instruction: Which word describes a girl who belongs to her parents as their own child?
quests.question: Daughter
quests.hint: Think about how a mother or father would describe their girl.
quests.explanation: Daughter describes a girl who belongs to her parents as their own child.
quests.funFact: Every girl is a daughter to her own parents, no matter how many siblings she has!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the child of your aunt or your uncle?
quests.question: Cousin
quests.hint: This family member calls your parent 'Aunt' or 'Uncle'.
quests.explanation: Cousin is the child of your aunt or your uncle.
quests.funFact: Cousins often become close friends, especially when families live near each other!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a woman who is your parent's own sibling?
quests.question: Aunt
quests.hint: She is in the same generation as your mother and father.
quests.explanation: Aunt is a woman who is your parent's own sibling.
quests.funFact: You might have several aunts if your mom and dad each have more than one sister!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a man on the family tree, connected beside your father, not above him?
quests.question: Uncle
quests.hint: He is your dad's own brother, part of the same generation.
quests.explanation: Uncle is drawn beside your father on a family tree, since they are siblings from the same generation.
quests.funFact: On a family tree, siblings like a father and his brother are usually drawn side by side!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a brother, but seen from his own parents' point of view instead of his siblings'?
quests.question: Son
quests.hint: The same boy is called this word by his mom and dad.
quests.explanation: Son describes the same boy who is a brother to his siblings, but seen from his parents' point of view.
quests.funFact: One single person can hold many family titles at once, like son, brother, and grandson!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a girl who will one day carry on her own family's memories and stories?
quests.question: Daughter
quests.hint: This word centers on the bond between a parent and their own child.
quests.explanation: Daughter describes a girl in her parent-and-child relationship, the one who may carry on family stories one day.
quests.funFact: Many families love passing down favorite recipes from one generation of daughters and sons to the next!

quests.instruction: Which family member is related to you through your aunt or uncle, not directly through your parents?
quests.question: Cousin
quests.hint: This relative is connected to you one step further out than a sibling.
quests.explanation: Cousin is related to you through your aunt or uncle, not directly through your own parents.
quests.funFact: Some families have huge groups of cousins who all grow up close to one another!

quests.instruction: Which family member is your mom's sister or your dad's sister?
quests.question: Aunt
quests.hint: She belongs to your parents' generation, not yours.
quests.explanation: Aunt is your mom's sister or your dad's sister.
quests.funFact: Some children have aunts on both their mom's side and their dad's side of the family!

quests.instruction: Which family member could be your father's younger or older brother?
quests.question: Uncle
quests.hint: He could be older or younger than your dad, and he is a sibling of his.
quests.explanation: Uncle could be your father's younger or older brother.
quests.funFact: Being an uncle or aunt is a special role that some people cherish their whole lives!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a boy who belongs to his parents as their own child?
quests.question: Son
quests.hint: Think about how a mother or father would describe their boy.
quests.explanation: Son describes a boy who belongs to his parents as their own child.
quests.funFact: Every boy is a son to his own parents, no matter how many siblings he has!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a parent's female child?
quests.question: Daughter
quests.hint: This word describes a girl, but from her parents' point of view.
quests.explanation: Daughter is the word for a parent's female child.
quests.funFact: A girl is called a 'daughter' by her parents and a 'sister' by her siblings — same person, different family words!

quests.instruction: Which family member might you see mostly at big family gatherings or holidays?
quests.question: Cousin
quests.hint: This relative does not live in your own house.
quests.explanation: Cousin is a family member you might see mostly at big family gatherings, since they live in a different home.
quests.funFact: Holiday gatherings are a favorite time for many children to catch up with their cousins!

quests.instruction: Whose children would be your cousins, if she has any?
quests.question: Aunt
quests.hint: Think of your parent's own sister.
quests.explanation: Your aunt's children, if she has any, are your cousins.
quests.funFact: Cousins and aunts often see each other at birthdays and holiday gatherings!

quests.instruction: Which family member is your mom's brother or your dad's brother?
quests.question: Uncle
quests.hint: He belongs to your parents' generation, not yours.
quests.explanation: Uncle is your mom's brother or your dad's brother.
quests.funFact: Some children have uncles on both their mom's side and their dad's side of the family!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a parent's male child?
quests.question: Son
quests.hint: This word describes a boy, but from his parents' point of view.
quests.explanation: Son is the word for a parent's male child.
quests.funFact: A boy is called a 'son' by his parents and a 'brother' by his siblings — same person, different family words!

quests.instruction: Which word means a girl who is someone's very own child?
quests.question: Daughter
quests.hint: This word is used only by that girl's own mother or father.
quests.explanation: Daughter means a girl who is someone's very own child.
quests.funFact: The bond between a parent and their daughter often grows and changes as the daughter grows older!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a child in the family whose parent is your aunt or uncle?
quests.question: Cousin
quests.hint: This is a relative your own age, from a different household.
quests.explanation: Cousin is a child in the family whose parent is your aunt or uncle.
quests.funFact: Many lifelong friendships between cousins begin with fun summer visits!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a woman on the family tree, connected beside your mother, not above her?
quests.question: Aunt
quests.hint: She is your mom's own sister, part of the same generation.
quests.explanation: Aunt is drawn beside your mother on a family tree, since they are siblings from the same generation.
quests.funFact: On a family tree, siblings like a mother and her sister are usually drawn side by side!

quests.instruction: Which family member is one generation above you, a man, but not one of your two parents?
quests.question: Uncle
quests.hint: He is your mother's or father's brother.
quests.explanation: Uncle is one generation above you and a man, but he is not one of your two parents.
quests.funFact: Uncles often love sharing funny stories about what your parent was like growing up!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a boy who will one day carry on his own family's memories and stories?
quests.question: Son
quests.hint: This is about the bond between a parent and their own child.
quests.explanation: Son describes a boy in his parent-and-child relationship, the one who may carry on family stories one day.
quests.funFact: Many families love passing down favorite stories from one generation of sons and daughters to the next!

quests.instruction: Which word means the female version of 'son'?
quests.question: Daughter
quests.hint: It is used by parents to describe their own girl.
quests.explanation: Daughter means the female version of 'son'.
quests.funFact: A family might have only daughters, only sons, or a mix of both!

quests.instruction: Which family member shares one of your grandparents, but not your own parents?
quests.question: Cousin
quests.hint: This relative is the child of your aunt or uncle.
quests.explanation: Cousin shares one of your grandparents with you, but not your own parents.
quests.funFact: A family tree shows cousins branching off from a shared grandparent!

quests.instruction: Which family member could be your mother's younger or older sister?
quests.question: Aunt
quests.hint: She could be older or younger than your mom, and she is a sibling of hers.
quests.explanation: Aunt could be your mother's younger or older sister.
quests.funFact: Being an aunt or uncle is a special role that some people cherish their whole lives!

quests.instruction: Which family member do your cousins call 'Dad'?
quests.question: Uncle
quests.hint: From your point of view, he is your parent's own brother.
quests.explanation: Uncle is the family member that your cousins call 'Dad', since he is their own father.
quests.funFact: The same person can be called different family names — a dad to his own kids and an uncle to yours!

quests.instruction: Which word means the male version of 'daughter'?
quests.question: Son
quests.hint: It is used by parents to describe their own boy.
quests.explanation: Son means the male version of 'daughter'.
quests.funFact: A family might have only sons, only daughters, or a mix of both!

quests.instruction: Which word means a girl, described from the point of view of her mother and father?
quests.question: Daughter
quests.hint: This word is the female match to 'son'.
quests.explanation: Daughter means a girl, described from the point of view of her mother and father.
quests.funFact: The word 'daughter' has been used in the English language for over a thousand years!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the same generation as you, but is not your brother or sister?
quests.question: Cousin
quests.hint: This relative shares a grandparent with you, but not a parent.
quests.explanation: Cousin is the same generation as you, but is not your brother or sister since you have different parents.
quests.funFact: You and a cousin are the same generation because you share a grandparent together!

quests.instruction: Which family member is your parent's sister, whether on your mom's side or your dad's side?
quests.question: Aunt
quests.hint: She could come from either side of your family.
quests.explanation: Aunt is your parent's sister, whether she comes from your mom's side or your dad's side.
quests.funFact: Different languages sometimes use different words for an aunt on your mom's side versus your dad's side!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the brother of your mother or your father?
quests.question: Uncle
quests.hint: His children, if he has any, would be your cousins.
quests.explanation: Uncle is the brother of your mother or your father.
quests.funFact: In some families, close family friends are also lovingly called 'Uncle' even without being related by blood!

quests.instruction: Which word means a boy, described from the point of view of his mother and father?
quests.question: Son
quests.hint: This word is the male match to 'daughter'.
quests.explanation: Son means a boy, described from the point of view of his mother and father.
quests.funFact: The word 'son' has been used in the English language for over a thousand years!
